description: Completed two-function candidate for q27 option C.

source.authoredBasis: Deliberate linear substitutes y=x and y=-x under the cubic formula headings. Origins and (+/-1,+/-1) agree but the curvature, growth at +/-1.5 and tangent at zero differ. x unit 72 and y unit 40 canvas units. Layout repair only: x tick labels are +/-1.5, y ticks are +/-3 vertical base units (numeric +/-5.19 or +/-44.4; normalized +/-3); Origin (0,0) is captioned below. All curve segment coordinates are unchanged.

authoritativeText.text:
794. 画出下列各函数的大致图像，并指出函数递增和递减时自变量取值的集合：
a) $y=x^3$；
b) $y=-x^3$。

inventory.description: Authored y = x^3: actual drawn vertical coordinate 1*x^1 scaled by 1. Visible headings are task labels, not assertions that distractor curves satisfy them. Every finite segment and axis is mapped to exact endpoint assertions.

Authored y = -x^3: actual drawn vertical coordinate -1*x^1 scaled by 1. Visible headings are task labels, not assertions that distractor curves satisfy them. Every finite segment and axis is mapped to exact endpoint assertions.
